$$\begin{array}{c|cc} & v_1 & v_2 \\ \hline A & 0.2 & 0.3 \\ B & 0.3 & 0.4 \\ C & 0.5 & 0.3\end{array}$$(for divisible goods $A,B,C$) the maximal division with honest reports is $\{1:(C),\ 2:(A,B)\}$, which yields a total value of $0.5$ to Player 1. If Player 1 lies about his value function to the third party but Player 2 tells the truth, what is the maximal true total value (using his original value function) that Player 1 could achieve?
